artworks.title: The Childhood of Jupiter
artworks.description: Schiavone’s Venetian canvas of infant Zeus among Cretan nurses and Curetes — the Dictaean cave milieu where Apollodorus places Ida and Adrasteia. Mannerist colour keeps the mountain-nymph’s world even when the title names the child, not the nurse.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca (nurses of Zeus)
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus names Ida and Adrasteia, daughters of Melisseus, as the nymphs who nurse Zeus in Crete while the Curetes clash their shields — distinct from Mount Ida and from Trojan Ida.
